title: Copy won Notion deals to a Google Sheet

conversation.text: Manual workflow: get all pages from my Notion database 8d2f4a6b-1c3e-4f5a-9b7d-2e4f6a8c0b1d where the Stage select is Won. For each deal, add a row to the 'Closed deals' tab of my Google Sheet (spreadsheet ID 1QwErTyUiOpAsDfGhJkLzXcVbNm0987654321). The tab has the header row Deal | Amount | Close date | Owner email. Fill in the page title, the Amount number, the Close date as YYYY-MM-DD, and the email address of the person in the Owner field.

description: Held-out case. The Notion output shape depends on the property type: a number stays a number, a date becomes a {start, end, time_zone} object whose start can carry a time, and people become an array of emails. The Sheets append must map these values to header names that contain spaces.

executionScenarios.name: won-deals-appended
executionScenarios.description: The query filters on Stage and each won deal becomes one sheet row with plain values.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The Notion API data source query (POST /v1/data_sources/8d2f4a6b-1c3e-4f5a-9b7d-2e4f6a8c0b1d/query) returns { "object": "list", "has_more": false, "next_cursor": null, "results": [{"object": "page", "id": "d1", "url": "https://www.notion.so/d1", "properties": {"Name": {"id": "title", "type": "title", "title": [{"type": "text", "plain_text": "Acme renewal", "text": {"content": "Acme renewal"}}]}, "Stage": {"id": "st", "type": "select", "select": {"name": "Won"}}, "Amount": {"id": "am", "type": "number", "number": 12000}, "Close date": {"id": "cd", "type": "date", "date": {"start": "2026-08-14", "end": null, "time_zone": null}}, "Owner": {"id": "ow", "type": "people", "people": [{"object": "user", "id": "u1", "name": "Dana Scully", "type": "person", "person": {"email": "dana@acme.test"}}]}}}, {"object": "page", "id": "d2", "url": "https://www.notion.so/d2", "properties": {"Name": {"id": "title", "type": "title", "title": [{"type": "text", "plain_text": "Globex pilot", "text": {"content": "Globex pilot"}}]}, "Stage": {"id": "st", "type": "select", "select": {"name": "Won"}}, "Amount": {"id": "am", "type": "number", "number": 4500.5}, "Close date": {"id": "cd", "type": "date", "date": {"start": "2026-08-20T15:30:00.000+02:00", "end": null, "time_zone": null}}, "Owner": {"id": "ow", "type": "people", "people": [{"object": "user", "id": "u2", "name": "Fox Mulder", "type": "person", "person": {"email": "fox@acme.test"}}]}}}] }. Return these raw API objects unchanged; the n8n node simplifies them itself. The 'Closed deals' tab has the header row Deal | Amount | Close date | Owner email and no data rows. Accept appends with 200.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The Notion query filter is Stage select equals Won. Then two rows are appended: Deal 'Acme renewal', Amount 12000, Close date '2026-08-14', Owner email 'dana@acme.test'; and Deal 'Globex pilot', Amount 4500.5, Close date '2026-08-20', Owner email 'fox@acme.test'. A date with a time part, an empty, undefined or '[object Object]' value, or a value in the wrong column FAILS.

outcomeExpectations: The Notion node filters on Stage select equals Won.
The Google Sheets node appends to the 'Closed deals' tab and maps Deal, Amount, Close date and Owner email from the simplified Notion values.
